risks.title: Margin compression in agricultural services
risks.score_rationale: This risk factor is central in the 10-K, with compressed margins due to delayed bioenergy policies, logistical conditions, and commercial uncertainties. The language is precise and repeated. The trend is stable compared to the prior year, but with intensifying challenges. The Industrial category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Decline in crushing margins
risks.score_rationale: Crushing profitability has been significantly reduced due to high production costs and weak processing margins. The language emphasizes sharply declining margins for soybean and rapeseed, particularly in North America and EMEA. This risk is central and critical. Critical Industrial category.

risks.title: Deferral of U.S. bioenergy policies
risks.score_rationale: The delay in U.S. bioenergy policies is explicitly mentioned as a negative factor for margins and volumes. Regulatory risk is clear, with a direct impact on predictability and profitability. Direct impact on tax credits and future production volumes.

risks.title: European deforestation regulation
risks.score_rationale: The evolution of European deforestation regulation is cited as a factor affecting volumes and margins. Regulatory risk is clear, with a direct impact on sales and refined products. Explicitly positioned in the text as a market factor influencing 2025 operations.

risks.title: Foreign exchange exposure
risks.score_rationale: Currency risk is explicitly mentioned in the MD&A as correlating revenue and expense fluctuations. The impact affects the euro, British pound, Canadian dollar, and Brazilian real. Although recurring, the impact is moderate in 2025. Medium-weighted Macro category.

risks.title: Software asset impairments
risks.score_rationale: A $179 million impairment on capitalized internal software is explicitly cited in the MD&A. This reflects a strategic shift toward more agile regional projects, revealing risks in prior global IT investments. Although costly, it is a one-time risk reflecting a strategic pivot. Medium-weighted Technology category.

risks.title: Uncertainty in the global trade landscape
risks.score_rationale: The evolving global trade landscape is explicitly mentioned as a factor contributing to margin compression in the Ag Services and Oilseeds segment. Uncertainty in trade policies, particularly in North America (noted with impact on soybean exports in Q4), directly affects operations and volumes. Highly impactful Macro category.
